title: Szydagis tests alleged crash debris with neutron activation

tellings.quote: My colleague Matthew Shadalagus has been working on studying debris from alleged crashes.

plain: A physicist named Matthew Szydagis, at the University at Albany, has been studying debris said to come from crashed unidentified craft, according to his colleague Kevin Knuth, a physicist who once worked at NASA. Knuth tells Michels this in passing and names no further source. The testing involves neutron activation, a lab method that works out which elements a sample contains, so the point is to learn whether the material is anything ordinary.
